tasks.label: pgck: web server
tasks.detail: Serve web/ (FastAPI: web/static + /api/* + /cklib) on the first free port from PGCK_BROWSER_PORT (default 8000). Prints the URL, then hot-reloads on edits to web/. Ctrl-C to stop.
tasks.command:
. .venv/bin/activate; export PGPORT="${PGPORT:-${POSTGRES_PORT:-$(docker port pgck-postgres 5432 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*://')}}"; export PGPORT="${PGPORT:-5432}"; export PGHOST="${PGHOST:-127.0.0.1}"; PORT="${PGCK_BROWSER_PORT:-8000}"; while lsof -iTCP:"$PORT" -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo "  port $PORT busy, trying $((PORT+1))"; PORT=$((PORT+1)); done; nc -z -w 1 "$PGHOST" "$PGPORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '
  !! postgres %s:%s is DOWN. web/app.py queries it on startup and will exit.
     run the "pgck: compose-up" task first, or use "pgck: web static" instead.
' "$PGHOST" "$PGPORT"; printf '
  pgCK web server
  URL     http://127.0.0.1:%s
  db      %s:%s
  root    web/static  (index.html)
  api     /api/board  /api/goals  /api/kernels  /healthz
  reload  on edits under web/
  stop    Ctrl-C

' "$PORT" "$PGHOST" "$PGPORT"; exec uvicorn web.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --reload --reload-dir web

tasks.label: pgck: web static
tasks.detail: Serve web/static as plain files on the first free port from PGCK_STATIC_PORT (default 8080). No database, no /api/*, no /cklib — for pure HTML/CSS/JS work when the kernel container is not up.
tasks.command:
PORT="${PGCK_STATIC_PORT:-8080}" && while lsof -iTCP:"$PORT" -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo "  port $PORT busy, trying $((PORT+1))"; PORT=$((PORT+1)); done; printf '
  pgCK web static  (files only — no DB, no /api)
  URL     http://127.0.0.1:%s
  root    web/static
  stop    Ctrl-C

' "$PORT"; exec python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --directory web/static --bind 127.0.0.1

tasks.label: pgck: dev dispatcher
tasks.detail: Local Tier-1 request/reply dispatcher (dev scaffold) so browser tools (tutorial/board/explorer/forge) work until the Rust CKA-4 dispatcher ships. Logs every request. Ctrl-C to stop.
